notes: The list, with the queued items, already covers essentially all of Bruch's works with a solo violin part: the three concertos, the Scottish Fantasy, the Serenade, Opp. 42, 57, 63, 65, 79 and 84, Kol Nidrei, and the Op. 88 violin-and-viola version. I left out the Op. 83 trio pieces (chamber music), the cello works Opp. 55, 56 and 61, and the viola Romanze Op. 85, for which I cannot name an established published violin edition.
